mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTickets, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_RESPONSE')), 0) AS pendingCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CLOSED'), 0) = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at <= resolution_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / SUM(status = 'CLOSED'), 1 ) END AS slaComplianceRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN first_response_at >= created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, first_response_at) END ), 1), 0) AS avgResponseMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN resolved_at >= created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, resolved_at) END ), 1), 0) AS avgResolutionMinutes FROM tickets
SELECT status AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets GROUP BY status ORDER BY FIELD( status, 'PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED' ), status
SELECT CAST(priority AS CHAR) AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority

SELECT trend.stat_date AS statDate, SUM(trend.created) AS created, SUM(trend.resolved) AS resolved FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS created, 0 AS resolved FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(resolved_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created, COUNT(*) AS resolved FROM tickets WHERE resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND resolved_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(resolved_at) ) trend GROUP BY trend.stat_date ORDER BY trend.stat_date

SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.title, t.description, t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, t.priority, t.status, t.creator_id AS creatorId, COALESCE(NULLIF(creator.real_name, ''), creator.username) AS creatorName, t.handler_id AS handlerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(handler.real_name, ''), handler.username) AS handlerName, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.assigned_at AS assignedAt, t.response_deadline AS responseDeadline, t.resolution_deadline AS resolutionDeadline, t.first_response_at AS firstResponseAt, t.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, t.closed_at AS closedAt, t.sla_status AS slaStatus, t.escalated_level AS escalatedLevel, t.remind_count AS remindCount, t.source, CAST(t.attachment_urls AS CHAR) AS attachmentUrls, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN ticket_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN users creator ON creator.id = t.creator_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.id = t.handler_id WHERE t.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING_RESPONSE'), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM( status IN ('PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED') AND sla_status IN ('NEAR_TIMEOUT', 'TIMEOUT', 'ESCALATED') ), 0) AS nearTimeoutCount, COALESCE(SUM( DATE(resolved_at) = CURDATE() OR DATE(closed_at) = CURDATE() ), 0) AS doneToday, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN resolved_at >= created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, resolved_at) END ), 1) AS avgResolutionMinutes FROM tickets WHERE handler_id = #{handlerId}

SELECT status AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets WHERE handler_id = #{handlerId} AND status IN ('PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED') GROUP BY status ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED')

SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.title, t.description, t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, t.priority, t.status, t.creator_id AS creatorId, COALESCE(NULLIF(creator.real_name, ''), creator.username) AS creatorName, t.handler_id AS handlerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(handler.real_name, ''), handler.username) AS handlerName, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.assigned_at AS assignedAt, t.response_deadline AS responseDeadline, t.resolution_deadline AS resolutionDeadline, t.first_response_at AS firstResponseAt, t.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, t.closed_at AS closedAt, t.sla_status AS slaStatus, t.escalated_level AS escalatedLevel, t.remind_count AS remindCount, t.source, CAST(t.attachment_urls AS CHAR) AS attachmentUrls, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN ticket_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN users creator ON creator.id = t.creator_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.id = t.handler_id WHERE t.handler_id = #{handlerId} AND t.status IN ('PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'PENDING_RESPONSE' THEN t.response_deadline ELSE t.resolution_deadline END, t.id LIMIT 8

SELECT u.id, u.id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.username, u.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, hp.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.handler_id = u.id AND t.status IN ('PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED') ) AS currentLoad, hp.avg_response_minutes AS avgResponseMinutes, hp.avg_resolution_minutes AS avgResolutionMinutes, hp.sla_compliance_rate AS slaComplianceRate, hp.rating_score AS ratingScore, u.status FROM handler_profiles hp INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = hp.user_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE u.id = #{handlerId} AND u.role = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT st.id AS skillId, st.name AS skillName, hs.proficiency FROM handler_profiles hp INNER JOIN handler_skills hs ON hs.handler_id = hp.id INNER JOIN skill_tags st ON st.id = hs.skill_tag_id WHERE hp.user_id = #{handlerId} ORDER BY st.id

SELECT u.id AS handlerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS realName, d.name AS departmentName, COALESCE(ticket_stats.assigned_count, 0) AS assignedCount, COALESCE(ticket_stats.resolved_count, 0) AS resolvedCount, COALESCE(ticket_stats.avg_response_minutes, hp.avg_response_minutes, 0) AS avgResponseMinutes, COALESCE(ticket_stats.avg_resolution_minutes, hp.avg_resolution_minutes, 0) AS avgResolutionMinutes, COALESCE(ticket_stats.sla_compliance_rate, hp.sla_compliance_rate, 100.0) AS slaComplianceRate, COALESCE(rating_stats.rating_score, hp.rating_score, 5.0) AS ratingScore FROM handler_profiles hp INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = hp.user_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.handler_id, COUNT(*) AS assigned_count, SUM(t.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) AS resolved_count, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN t.first_response_at >= t.created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, t.created_at, t.first_response_at) END ), 1) AS avg_response_minutes, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN t.resolved_at >= t.created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, t.created_at, t.resolved_at) END ), 1) AS avg_resolution_minutes, CASE WHEN SUM(t.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND( SUM( t.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') AND t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND t.resolution_deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.resolved_at <= t.resolution_deadline ) * 100.0 / SUM(t.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')), 1 ) END AS sla_compliance_rate FROM tickets t WHERE t.handler_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.handler_id ) ticket_stats ON ticket_stats.handler_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.handler_id, ROUND(AVG(tr.rating), 1) AS rating_score FROM tickets t INNER JOIN ticket_ratings tr ON tr.ticket_id = t.id WHERE t.handler_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.handler_id ) rating_stats ON rating_stats.handler_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 1 AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY u.id

WITH RECURSIVE category_roots AS ( SELECT id AS category_id, id AS root_category_id FROM ticket_categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT child.id AS category_id, category_roots.root_category_id FROM ticket_categories child INNER JOIN category_roots ON child.parent_id = category_roots.category_id ) SELECT root.id AS categoryId, root.name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN t.resolved_at >= t.created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, t.created_at, t.resolved_at) ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS avgResolutionMinutes FROM tickets t INNER JOIN category_roots ON category_roots.category_id = t.category_id INNER JOIN ticket_categories root ON root.id = category_roots.root_category_id GROUP BY root.id, root.name ORDER BY count DESC, root.id
